answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 3127 Country: United States of America Title: If we are fasting and we do wudu, after we do kuli, you say in one of your fataawa to spit once and twice, I spit more than this, but after very little time, sometimes I swallow and I feel as if water went down my throat, yet I am not absolutely sure, since I spit, should I disregard this or should I make qaza for this fast? Question: If we are fasting and we do wudu, after we do kuli, you say in one of your fataawa to spit once and twice, I spit more than this, but after very little time, sometimes I swallow and I feel as if water went down my throat, yet I am not absolutely sure, since I spit, should I disregard this or should I make qaza for this fast? Answer ID: 3127 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 208/208=L) In the abovementioned case, you do not have to make up (re-perform) the missed sawm (fast): اذا بقی بعد المضمضۃ ماء فابتلعہ بالبزاق لم یفطر لتعذر الاحتراز ( الشامی: 3/367، ط زکریا دیوبند ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
